Units with rates and results of the last 12 months
One row per unit with rates and fixed costs; nights, revenue, ADR (the average price of a night sold), occupancy, break-even rate and rate card figures fill in by themselves.
Pricing calendar by unit and week with suggested rate
One row per unit and week: base rate, season, demand, local event, listed rate, booked and free nights; the suggested rate, gap to it and fill check fill in by themselves.
Revenue left at the booked rate
Seasons with the price factor of each month
Twelve calendar months with the season and the price factor against the base rate; the rate card tools and the unit rate cards read these.
Bookings with channel, rate and lead time
One row per booking: unit, guest, channel, dates, nightly rate and revenue; lead time, rate against base, platform fee and guest offer prices fill in by themselves.
Unit months with occupancy, ADR and RevPAR
One row per unit and month: available and booked nights and room revenue; occupancy, ADR, RevPAR (revenue per available night) and the gap to your target fill in by themselves.
Rate changes with change percent and bookings after
One row per rate change: unit, old and new rate, reason and who changed it; the change percent, the direction and the bookings made in the next 14 days fill in by themselves.
Local events with demand lift and days to the event
One row per local event that changes demand: city, dates and the demand lift; the days to the event, its nights, the check and the free nights still listed in the event week fill in by themselves.
Free nights listed in the event
Comparable listings with the gap to our rate
One row per comparable listing near one of your units: its weekday and weekend rate and review score; our base rate, the gap to it and who is priced above or below us fill in by themselves.
Discount rules with the example price
One row per discount rule: trigger, units covered, days before check-in, percent off and minimum nights; the example price and the rule check fill in by themselves.
Example rate on an average unit
Minimum-stay rules by unit and season
One row per unit and season: the shortest stay on weekdays, weekends and for a gap; the strictest rule, gap check and review check fill in by themselves.
Gap nights with offer rate and revenue recovered
One row per free night between two bookings: unit, usual rate and discount offered; the offer rate, revenue recovered and revenue missed fill in by themselves.
Last-minute fills with discount and revenue
One row per booking made close to check-in: unit, usual and booked rate, nights and channel; the discount given, the revenue and how late the fill was fill in by themselves.
Cleaning fee review with margin on the fee
One row per unit: cleaner hours, supplies and linen for one turnover (the clean and reset between stays); cost, margin on the fee and the fee for your target fill in by themselves.
Channels with platform fee and payout days
Booking platforms and direct routes with the fee and the days to the payout (the money a platform sends the host after a stay starts); the booking and break-even sheets read these.
City and season rates with local occupancy tax
One row per city and season: local occupancy tax (a tax on each night, collected from the guest) and a demand factor; the ADR and occupancy of your units there fill in by themselves.
Local tax on an ADR night
Break-even rate and occupancy for each unit
One row per unit: other fixed cost, cost per night and target occupancy; fixed cost, break-even rate after platform fees, margin and occupancy needed fill in by themselves.
Occupancy needed at the base rate
Direct offers with bookings and revenue
One row per direct offer code: unit, discount, valid dates, bookings and revenue; the offer status, revenue per booking and days left fill in by themselves.
One row per price test: unit, start, weeks, rate before and tested, nights booked and result; change percent, occupancy and revenue per week fill in by themselves.
One row per unit and check-in weekday over 12 months: nights and ADR with the season taken out; share of nights, premium and the weekend lift check fill in by themselves.
Team with hours and rate changes made
The host, the co-host (a helper who handles guests for a fee), four cleaners, two handypeople and four outside contacts; the rate changes each person made fill in by themselves.

Guest: direct price beats the platform
Hello {guest}, booking {unit} direct costs {direct_rate} a night instead of {nightly_rate}, with no platform fee. Shall I hold your dates?
Guest: discount on the night before
Hello {guest}, {unit} is free the night before your stay from {check_in}. You can add it at {gap_rate} a night. Would you like it?
Hello {guest}, {unit} has dates free at the last-minute rate of {lastmin_rate} a night. Reply if you would like to book.
Guest: a weekly stay discount for you
Hello {guest}, stay 7 nights or more in {unit} and pay {weekly_rate} a night instead of {nightly_rate}. Shall I check your dates?
Hello {guest}, thank you for staying in {unit}. Come back and book direct for {direct_rate} a night.
Guest: your dates are free at a new rate
Hello {guest}, your dates in {unit} are free again at {nightly_rate} a night for {nights} nights. Would you like to book?
Guest: the price for the unit changes
Hello {guest}, the price of {unit} for stays from {check_in} will change soon. Your quote is {nightly_rate} a night. Reply today to keep it.
Hello {guest}, your dates in {unit} need a stay of at least {nights} nights. Can you extend your stay?
Hello {guest}, your quote for {unit}: {nights} nights from {check_in} at {nightly_rate} a night, cleaning fee {cleaning_fee}, total {gross}.
Hello {guest}, thank you for booking {unit} direct. Your total is {gross}. We look forward to your stay on {check_in}.
Guest: a night is open after your stay
Hello {guest}, the night after your stay, {check_out}, is free in {unit}. Stay one more night at {gap_rate}.
Hello {guest}, a local festival week is coming and {unit} fills fast. Book early: the rate is {nightly_rate} a night now.
Owner: the rate for your unit changed
Hello, the rate for {unit} changed from {old_rate} to {new_rate} on {date}. Reason: {reason}.
Owner: the seasonal rate card is ready
Hello {owner}, the rate card for {name} is ready: lowest season {low_rate}, peak season {peak_rate}, peak weekend {peak_weekend}.
Owner: sold out in the event week
Hello, {unit} has {booked_nights} nights booked in the week of {week} ({event}) at {avg_booked_rate}. The suggested rate was {suggested_rate}.
Hello, {comparable} charges {weekday_rate} on weekdays against our {our_rate} for {unit}. I am looking at the price.
Hello, the break-even rate for {unit} is {break_even_rate} and the base rate is {base_rate}. We need to talk about the price.
Owner: your price test has ended
Hello, the price test on {unit} has ended. We tested {rate_tested} for {weeks} weeks and booked {nights_booked} nights.
Owner: average rate below base rate
Hello {owner}, the average price of a night sold at {name} over 12 months is {adr_12m}, against a base rate of {base_rate}.
Hello, the minimum stay for {unit} changes to {weekday_min} nights on weekdays and {weekend_min} on weekends.
Hello, please set the listed rate for {unit} in the week of {week} to {suggested_rate}. It is {listed_rate} now.
Co-host: guests ask about the event
Hello, guests are asking about {event} from {start_date}. Please answer with the new rate and the minimum stay. Demand lift: {demand_lift}.
Co-host: gap nights to fill this week
Hello, {nights_free} free nights in {unit} on {date}. Please offer them at {offer_rate} a night.
Co-host: confirm the new minimum stay
Hello, please confirm that {unit} now has a minimum of {weekday_min} nights on weekdays and {weekend_min} on weekends.
Host: the weekly pricing review is ready
Hello, the pricing review is ready. {unit}, week of {week}: listed {listed_rate}, suggested {suggested_rate}.
Host: a unit has free nights next week
Hello, {unit} has {free_nights} free nights in the week of {week}. Please consider a gap or last-minute offer.
